title: New Play Store Features Boost Paid Game Visibility and Download Management
seoTitle: New Play Store Features Boost Paid Game Visibility
subtitle: Google is testing improvements that simplify selecting premium games and managing installations
excerpt: The Play Store is testing two new features: a distinct layout for paid games, highlighting banners and essential info, and a pause button that.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The latest version of the Play Store (v53.0) brought two changes that explain the increase in "play store" searches in recent days. While developers seek greater prominence for their premium games, users are testing a feature that allows pausing and resuming downloads without canceling the operation.

New Interface for Paid Games

Google is developing an exclusive layout for paid games. Unlike the current view, which uses the same design as free games, the new UI highlights the title's banner image and displays ratings, age restrictions, device compatibility, and other details at the bottom of the image.

This proposal is still under development and has not been officially launched. Among the information not yet displayed are download size and number of installations, but the company may include them in future iterations.

Download Pause and Resume Feature

Another new feature tested in the same version allows users to pause an ongoing download and resume it later. Previously, the only option available was to cancel the transfer.

Upon tapping the “Pause” button, the download is interrupted, and the “Resume” option appears. The Play Store's internal manager lists paused downloads, making it easy to resume them without having to search for the app again. This functionality can be useful for those who wish to prioritize app installation or avoid mobile data consumption on limited connections.

How Changes Appear in System Updates

The changes are part of the Google System Updates release notes for August 2026, which record the inclusion of new features in Play Store v53.0. The notes also mention previous versions of the store (v52.9, v52.8, etc.) that contained other improvements, but the UI for paid games and download pausing are highlighted only in the latest version.

Impact for Developers and Brazilian Users

For developers, the distinct layout can improve the visibility of premium titles, helping to highlight differentiators such as graphic quality or exclusive content. For users, pausing downloads offers greater control over data consumption and the order of app installation, especially on devices with limited mobile connection.n

Although there is no official release date yet, the demonstrations already available indicate that Google intends to integrate these functions into future Play Store updates. Those interested can follow upcoming versions of the store to check when the new features will arrive on their devices.

With information from Android Authority, jetstream.blog.
